response.sql: WITH race_stats AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS FLOAT)) as avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), avg_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) as value FROM race_stats) SELECT SUM(rs.total_points) as sum_total_points, AVG(rs.avg_laps) as avg_avg_laps, AVG(rs.total_points - at.value) as avg_excess FROM race_stats rs CROSS JOIN avg_total at WHERE rs.total_points > at.value;
